title: On Concluding the meeting before noon
subtitle: 法律规则 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）
meta: 主题语境：法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）　|　核心词汇：conclude　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 conclude 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 the trader ① concluded the meeting before noon on the same day, and every partner in the market said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the trader ② concludes the meeting before noon before dawn without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ conclude the meeting before noon at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ concluded the meeting before noon before — a line in the list for October 1957 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Concluding the meeting before noon on the same day, the trader said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the basket at the far stall, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ conclude that the account was false before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Conclude that the account was false at once and never mention it again.

By 1970 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the list, and a new partner from the next market ⑧ concludes that the account was false on the same day every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stall, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ concluded the meeting before noon again when nobody else would.

⑩ To conclude the meeting before noon, my mother said in 1975, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the market remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the market forgets, somebody concludes the meeting before noon before dawn again and somebody must conclude the meeting before noon on the same day all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 结束（一般过去式 concluded the meeting before noon：1963 年货商头一回这样做，当天就）
B. v. 结束（一般现在 concludes the meeting before noon：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 结束（不定式 to conclude the meeting before noon：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 结束（过去完成时 had concluded the meeting before noon：1957 年十月的货单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 结束（动名词 concluding the meeting before noon 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 断定（conclude that the account was false：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去断定断定那份记载不实）
G. v. 断定（conclude that the account was false：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 结束（后段两处：新来的伙计照例 concludes that the account was false，而母亲又一次 concluded the meeting before noon）

items.q: to conclude the meeting before noon
concluded the meeting before noon before
conclude that the account was false before dawn
conclude that the account was false at once
concludes that the account was false on the same day
concluded the meeting before noon again
to conclude the meeting before noon

answers.why: conclude 意为“结束”，1963 年货商当天就结束中午前散了会，那是集市里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 concluded。
conclude 意为“结束”，自那以后货商天没亮就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 concludes。
conclude 意为“结束”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯结束中午前散了会”，此处为不定式 to conclude the meeting before noon。
conclude 意为“结束”，货单里 十月 那行字说明早在 1970 年之前就有人结束过，故用过去完成时 had concluded。
conclude 意为“结束”，货商说“结束中午前散了会这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 concluding the meeting before noon 作主语。
conclude 意为“断定”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去断定断定那份记载不实”，should ever 之后用原形 conclude that the account was false。
conclude 意为“断定”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻断定断定那份记载不实（conclude that the account was false at once），以后再也不要提起。
conclude 意为“结束”，新来的伙计每个星期都照例断定断定那份记载不实，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 concludes。
conclude 意为“结束”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当天就结束中午前散了会，用一般过去式 concluded 叙述。
conclude 意为“结束”，结尾那句是母亲 1975 年的话：要结束中午前散了会，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和集市记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1963 年，货商当天就结束中午前散了会；集市里每一个伙计都说这是头一回。（concluded the meeting before noon）
多年以后，货商仍天没亮就做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（concludes the meeting before noon）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯结束中午前散了会这件事本身。（to conclude the meeting before noon）
早在 1957 年就有人结束中午前散了会，十月那天货单上的一行字就是证据。（had concluded the meeting before noon）
货商说过，当天就结束中午前散了会这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（concluding the meeting before noon 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻断定断定那份记载不实，以后再也不要提起。（conclude that the account was false，祈使句）
answers: In 1963 the trader concluded the meeting before noon on the same day, and every partner in the market said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three weeks on, the trader still concludes the meeting before noon before dawn without being asked.
My mother said later that to conclude the meeting before noon at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had concluded the meeting before noon long before 1970, and the line in the list for October proves it.
Concluding the meeting before noon on the same day, the trader said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Conclude that the account was false at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 conclude 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1963 the trader concluded the meeting before noon on the same day, and nobody in the market forgot it.
Even now the trader concludes the meeting before noon before dawn whenever the market asks.
Concluding the meeting before noon on the same day, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever conclude that the account was false before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new partner from the next market concludes that the account was false on the same day every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother concluded the meeting before noon again, and the market remembered that half.
